policy: Rejected generations stay quarantined. Runtime uses only the accepted alias or code-native implementation named here.

decisions.reason: Generated candidates contained opaque panels; the deterministic starburst is readable and palette-safe.
Generated candidates were boxed or spherical; the deterministic ground ring matches the gameplay hit shape.
Idle candidates cropped props or read as walk cycles; the canonical model preserves identity.
Pound candidates lost clipboard continuity or scale; charge provides a complete animated heavy action.
Grab candidates fragmented the glider; lash preserves Cleo and supplies a readable committed attack.
Walk candidates cropped or broke the shovel; runtime movement bob keeps the accepted idle visibly moving.
Duel candidates broke the shovel; tunnel is the accepted full-shovel attack sequence.
Stance candidates lost the shovel; telegraph retains canonical silhouette and anticipation.
Direct candidates repeatedly lost the full cane; telegraph supplies stable theatrical gestures.
Combo candidates were boxed or lost the cane; counter is the accepted cane-action sequence.
Enrage candidates failed scale and cane continuity; telegraph plus runtime red desperation treatment remains readable.
